meta.text: Step 1, baseline DBU-hours: 8 workers × 1.5 hours equals 12 DBU-hours. Step 2, Photon: 8 workers × 40 minutes, which is two-thirds of an hour, × 1.5R gives us 8 DBU-hours. Photon uses 33 percent fewer DBU-hours, so it is cheaper in DBUs — and since the job also finishes faster, it's likely cheaper in VM cost too.
